purpose: Heterologous CDS added to the S288C transcriptome so that reads from the bacterial transgenes of SRP342112 have somewhere to map. Wild-type CDS are used deliberately: the strains carry point-mutant variants (AdhA 29C8, IlvC 6E6) whose reads still map to the wild-type sequence.
